subject: sentences
title: Whose is it?
about: Whose is it: possessive nouns (Sam's hat, the dog's bone) and possessive pronouns (my, your, his, her, our, their, yours). Both sit in the Nouns and Pronouns rows of NC's K-1 grammar continuum under L.1.1 (DPI's own example is the dog's collar); writing the apostrophe is a grade 2 convention, so here he only reads it.
tip: Ask who the thing belongs to first, then have him read the sentence back with his choice in it.

cards.q: The hat belongs to Sam. It is ___ hat.
cards.sayQ: The hat belongs to Sam. It is blank hat. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: The hat belongs to Sam, so it is Sam's hat. The little mark and the s mean it belongs to Sam.

cards.q: Ben has a ball. Whose ball is it?
cards.note: Whose asks who it belongs to. Ben has it, so it is Ben's.

cards.q: Mia has a drum. Whose drum is it?
cards.note: Mia has the drum, so it is Mia's drum.

cards.q: The bone belongs to the dog. It is the ___ bone.
cards.sayQ: The bone belongs to the dog. It is the blank bone. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Animals can own things too. The bone belongs to the dog, so it is the dog's bone.

cards.q: Pick the way to write it: the bike that belongs to Max.
cards.note: Add the little mark and an s to Max to show the bike is his: Max's bike.

cards.q: Pick the way to write it: the cup that belongs to Zoe.
cards.note: The owner comes first with the little mark and an s, then the thing: Zoe's cup.

cards.q: Ava's dog is big. Whose dog is big?
cards.note: The little mark and the s on Ava tell you the dog is hers.

cards.q: Dad's car is red. Whose car is red?
cards.note: The little mark and the s on Dad tell you the car is his.

cards.q: I have a cat. It is ___ cat.
cards.sayQ: I have a cat. It is blank cat. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: I have it, so it is my cat. My goes with I.

cards.q: You have a hat. It is ___ hat.
cards.sayQ: You have a hat. It is blank hat. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: You have it, so it is your hat. Your goes with you.

cards.q: Mia and Ben have a dog. It is ___ dog.
cards.sayQ: Mia and Ben have a dog. It is blank dog. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: The dog belongs to both Mia and Ben, so it is their dog. Their is for more than one person.

cards.q: Max and I have a tent. It is ___ tent.
cards.sayQ: Max and I have a tent. It is blank tent. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Max and I together are we, so it is our tent. Our goes with we.

cards.q: That is Sam's bike. That is ___ bike.
cards.sayQ: That is Sam's bike. That is blank bike. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Sam is a boy, so Sam's bike is his bike.

cards.q: That is Ava's cap. That is ___ cap.
cards.sayQ: That is Ava's cap. That is blank cap. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: Ava is a girl, so Ava's cap is her cap.

cards.q: This toy is for you. It is ___.
cards.sayQ: This toy is for you. It is blank. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: If it is for you, it is yours. Yours is your with an s, and it can stand at the end by itself.

cards.q: The hens have a pen. It is ___ pen.
cards.sayQ: The hens have a pen. It is blank pen. Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: More than one hen, so it is their pen. Their works for animals and things too.
